thread:
maria: FYIcustomers hitting SSO failures after last-night KMS rotation. SAML assertions failing to decrypt, 401s reported.
priya: confirmed we rotated alias 'redwood-sso-prod' at 02:14 UTC per runbook.
jon: any error lines?
maria: logs show:
```
ERROR: decrypt assertion: invalid_envelope_header: context mismatch (key-id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:000000:key/abcd1234)
```
jon: context mismatch implies the encryption context in the envelope doesn't match what KMS expects. Did we change what we include in the context?
priya: we pushed a small RBAC change ~02:10 that removed legacy mapping from 'staff' to 'admin'. unrelated?
jon: could be. also I see the deploy bumped "kms-envelope" from 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0 in package.json. That library changed how it formats the context (it now prefixes a version marker).
priya: oh. so assertions encrypted with the v1 format won't decrypt with a key that was created or rotated expecting v2 context.
infra-oncall: deploy-bot: canary at 02:09, promoted at 02:12. audit-bot logs: "kms:KeyRotation by deploy-service alias=redwood-sso-prod id=xyz-789 ts=2024-11-07T02:14:12Z"
audit-bot: also recorded new encryptions by scim-service 02:16-02:20.
maria: customers see "SAML assertion decryption error: invalid encryption context" before our RBAC code runs.
jon: short mitigation plan: 1) emergency patch to attempt decrypt with both v1 and v2 context (dual-decrypt fallback), 2) pin kms-envelope to 1.4.x and rollback library in services, 3) re-encrypt persisted SAML blobs that used the non-canonical format.
priya: I'll pin and open a PR to back it out. filed ticket INFR-4873 to track re-encrypt work.
jon: pushed a quick fallback to staging that tries both context variants and logs which matched. rolling to prod now. audit-bot: "provisional-mitigation-deploy by jon at 03:05 UTC"
infra-oncall: added metric sso.decrypt_mismatch.count and alerted at >=5/5m.
maria: owners: jon (patch + monitoring), priya (pin + runbook update), infra-oncall (re-encrypt job + customer coordination).
priya: runbook update note: when rotating SSO KMS keys validate decrypt across a staging tenant and check library versioning. I'll submit PR.
jon: follow-up: schedule a service-level job to re-encrypt stored assertions with canonical v1 headers (or a canonical agreed version) after we decide on a final format.
priya: ETA 48h for full re-encrypt of impacted tenants, will coordinate with CS for affected customers.
maria: summary in channel: root cause = envelope format drift after library bump + key rotation; impact = SAML assertion decrypt failure; mitigation = dual-decrypt fallback, library rollback, re-encrypt job; next steps = runbook PR + re-encrypt + postmortem. :thumbsup:
